reviews.text: I was very pleased with the excellent customer service from Just In Case. My appointment was scheduled right away and the technician (Justin) was punctual and efficient . Great experience if you have to call a plumber, call Just In Case.
reviews.author: Ken G.

reviews.text: We had two emergency that Justin and his staff did a great job in a short period of time. The job was completed with no rework. I would recommend Just In Case Plumbing & Electrical to family and friends.
reviews.author: Lewis B.

reviews.text: I am very pleased with the service we received from Just In Case! We had 2 tankless hot water systems installed. The owner and crew provided good communication about the job and time frame. They arrived in a timely manner, which we appreciate.
reviews.author: Rosemarie C.
